description: A gothic stone church ruin with a tall tracery window and spires on the left, roofless and broken, beside an angular pink-red sandstone building with a tall glass wall of figure sculptures on the right. A wooden cross made of two timbers stands in rubble in the foreground under a dark stormy sky. Painted in an oil style. Small lettering, apparently reading FATHER FORGIVE, is painted on a low wall at lower left.
reason: Painted text is visible on the low stone wall at lower left, reading apparently FATHER FORGIVE. Remove or repaint that wall without lettering.
